limitations: Source: 交通运输部长江航务管理局, July and August 2026 长江干散货运价指数 and 长江集装箱运价指数. One original publisher family; six bulk and four container series, not ten independent sources.

All ten monthly index series use January 2023=1000. Published index points are the reader values. No route-specific RMB/ton or RMB/TEU prices, traded contracts, physical freight volumes or currency tax treatment are inferred from index levels.

Only 20 published current-month levels are observations. Eighty other original numerical cells (prior-year month, previous month, published MoM and YoY) remain supplemental CSV fields, not additional periods or inferred history.

Original July catalogue date is 2026-08-05; the PDF upload path contains 20260818. Per-row catalogue dates and true acquisition times are retained. The combined SourceInput publication date is the later 2026-09-30 release; earliest availability and historical point-in-time versions are not certified.

July values equal the published August previous-month cells for all ten series. August bulk composite publisher MoM is -3.0%, versus -2.9% when rounding displayed levels; August upstream container publisher MoM is +0.7%, versus +0.8%. Both original percentages and recomputations are preserved. These differences are not silently repaired or by themselves asserted to be publisher errors.

Both composites overlap their component categories/regions. Index levels are not additive and no weighting reconstruction or company benefit inference is made. Detailed lane, vessel, shipper, distance weights and sample counts are not disclosed by these one-page tables.
